snippet.title: Chornobyl Quest — Official Game Trailer | 24HIT GAMES
snippet.description:
Chornobyl Quest is a thrilling adventure set in the heart of the Zone.

Dive into a unique blend of survival, base defense, crafting, and exploration inspired by the legendary stalker universe. Mutants show no mercy, and anomalies can be either deadly traps or sources of priceless artifacts.

As a true stalker, you must:

- Scavenge resources in ruined labs, deserted towns, and abandoned military bases;

- Craft weapons from whatever you can find in the Zone.

- Build defenses around your base to withstand waves of mutants and raiders.

- Explore a map filled with danger, secrets, and epic adventures.

Download Chornobyl Quest now and start your deadly but unforgettable journey through the Zone. Survive, explore, build, and defend — become the one they call a true stalker.

🚀 Download via Store Links in bio for free!
